decision: adapt (idea); clean-room, GPL-3.0 code and assets
rule: Order of one melee hit: block or parry check first (Block outcome, poise change, parry hook); then the health change event; for slashing, a drain on energy decides between a poise change and extra health damage; then knockback effects from the attack, scaled by strength; then on the next system pass the target poise is read against thresholds 50, 30, 15, 5 to pick Normal, Interrupted, Stunned, Dazed or KnockedDown. A stagger resets poise to full, sets a window of stagger length plus 1.0 s during which poise changes are ignored, sets the Stunned character state (unless downed), emits a PoiseChange outcome for the client, and for KnockedDown emits a knockback event of impulse 10.0 times the stored direction. Knockback magnitude is 50.0 times strength times the resistance and attacker multipliers (marked TEMP). The client maps outcomes to sounds and particles only.
keep: Poise ladder as the stagger system (replaces hit stop)
Immunity window after a stagger so three hits cannot chain
Separate health and poise events from the same hit
Per-state sound lists so the state can be learned by sound
Server state drives client outcomes; client never decides the stagger
change: Stunned doc says knocked back horizontally but code gives no impulse (poise.rs:68 vs 97-105). Fix: add stagger_push_on_stunned or fix the doc.
Sound cooldown is not applied on the client outcome path; outcome handler calls emit_sfx directly (sfx/mod.rs:907-929). Fix: per-entity, per-sound cooldown on that path.
Threshold field is used as subtitle duration on the outcome path (audio/mod.rs:640, 664) and as cooldown in the state mapper (event_mapper/combat/mod.rs:127). Fix: two fields.
Poise regen rate is never reset and grows during the immunity window while regen is ignored (poise.rs:241-250, 220-222). Fix: reset on hit; do not raise while ignored.
look_test: Three enemies at once in the fight at 375 wide, same hit pattern, three variants: numbers only; ladder with Interrupted and Stunned (0.4 s and 0.7 s) with per-state sound; full ladder including Dazed and KnockedDown (3 s down). Judge whether a staggered enemy is readable among three, and whether the immunity window stops a stun loop.
